recent_posts.text:
Outtakes from a very special evening in SF, hosted in partnership with Silicon Valley Bank and Lightspeed. 💫

A room full of Founders and operators from some of the most exciting companies, all building for the globe from Day 1. 

A big takeaway from the evening: The old playbook of expanding across geographies (years of groundwork, local entities, endless compliance) is dead. AI collapsed the timeline, and now going global is a decision you make on Day 1, not a milestone you earn years later.

Thank you to everyone who came out. This is just the beginning.

🥁 Exciting news! Razorpay has partnered with NPCI Bharat BillPay Limited (NBBL) to bring a fast NetBanking experience to businesses and consumers across India.

Introducing Banking Connect - a standardised, mobile-first NetBanking experience built for the next era of digital payments.

✨ We believe NetBanking has earned India’s trust for years. Today, we’re striving to make the experience even better.
✅One network connecting banks, PAs, and users.
✅All participant banks are enabled through one integration.
✅Mobile-first Intent & QR flows for fast payments.
✅Unified settlements and refunds .

For businesses, it means simpler enablement and fewer drop-offs. For users, it means NetBanking that is built for today.
⚡UPI-like speed.
🛡️The trust of the bank.
🚀NetBanking 2.0, entering its next era.

Razorpay🤝NPCI NBBL

To read more: https://lnkd.in/dhn2Qmah

Thousands of builders will be building on Hermes, and we're thrilled to welcome some of the best builders to Razorpay.

Super pumped to be part of this global wave.

notes: Stored LinkedIn observations; employee_count is observed platform headcount, not audited payroll.
Recent means newest stored posts, not a live feed. Observation time differs from publication time.
Post counters are latest stored values, not sums across crawls. Source zeros can include parser defaults.
Negative source counters become null. Profile reaction/comment totals cover the observed page cards, not lifetime engagement.
Recorded sector is a source label and can disagree with the company classification.

data.note: Only the requested field is returned. Missing data is not zero; array limits are explicit.

notes: Availability describes stored observations, not current accuracy or contact entitlement. Request one field at /v1/companies/field.
